description: Move one or many files into a folder, optionally renaming a single one. Sources are paths, or "id:<fileId>" to name one directly. Works the same for a Google Doc as for a PDF, which is the reason to use this instead of moving files in a synced local copy: moving a Doc's placeholder there deletes the Doc and uploads a small shortcut file in its place. Call with dry_run first; the plan names every collision.

dry_run.description: Compute the plan and write nothing.

rename_to.description: Only legal with a single source.

name: move_file
title: Move files
